findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — A test reading `(Path(__file__).parent / '../brand' / 'logo.svg').read_text()` is missed when `brand/logo.svg` changes. The join regex requires a quoted first argument, so it cannot fold `Path(__file__)`; the subsequent scan checks `../brand` and `logo.svg` separately, neither of which resolves to the changed file. Consequently, this test-read asset receives light review and skips every CI test group. Literal `.joinpath()` constructions have the same gap. The generated `.forge/review-tests.py:55` repeats the defect. The added relative-path test uses one complete path literal, so it does not catch this regression.
findings.title: Preserve full checks for file-relative path joins

stop.proposed: cut the code that invites these findings; or replace the cases with one general rule; or narrow that Done when item; or make it fail closed
stop.reason: Owner rule of 20 October 2026: at most two review rounds; a finding left after round two that is not a P0 becomes a follow-up. A test that builds an asset path from Path(__file__) joins is a rare case.
